title: Google SRE：多視窗error-budget burn與恢復後告警解除
titleEn: Google SRE: multiwindow error-budget burn and alert reset after recovery
subcategoryTitle: 事件演練、服務恢復與可驗證交接
subcategoryTitleEn: Incident exercises, service recovery and verifiable handoffs
summary: 從相同請求定義計算長短視窗錯誤比例與burn rate，明確實作兩視窗同時超標的教學條件，保留無流量為未知。
summaryEn: Calculate error ratios and burn rates from consistent request definitions in long and short windows. Implement the explicit teaching condition that both windows exceed threshold, keeping zero-traffic windows unknown.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 固定SLO與請求分母

stages.description: 服務錯誤率已恢復，舊版單一長視窗規則仍保留先前事故使告警持續；學徒需要分開已消耗預算與目前是否仍快速消耗。 從相同請求定義計算長短視窗錯誤比例與burn rate，明確實作兩視窗同時超標的教學條件，保留無流量為未知。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 先以整數errors及requests建立兩視窗，避免把百分比0.1與比例0.001混用；每窗保留start、end及evaluation_time。用合成流量在短窗停止錯誤，觀察長窗仍高但AND解除，原已消耗預算仍留在帳本。
stages.descriptionEn: A service has recovered, but a legacy long-window-only rule still contains the incident and keeps an alert active. The apprentice must distinguish already-consumed budget from whether rapid consumption is continuing now. Calculate error ratios and burn rates from consistent request definitions in long and short windows. Implement the explicit teaching condition that both windows exceed threshold, keeping zero-traffic windows unknown. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Build both windows from integer errors and requests, avoiding confusion between 0.1 percent and proportion 0.001. Preserve start, end and evaluation_time for each. Stop synthetic errors in the short window and observe the conjunction clear while long burn remains elevated, retaining already-consumed budget in its ledger.
